title: Catalogue the native select (class .select) and give the authority assignment vocabulary

review.applied: alias list revised (req 1), component-notes cross-ref added (req 2), convergence criterion rewritten to the verified contract (req 3), delete probes added to non-regression (req 4); .select also added to the :focus-visible group (review note)

problem: Downstream agents (4 independent runs) needed a compact single-select for a small fixed set and could not cite any canon: the styled native <select> exists in Triage (CSS + examples + a Forms demo) but is not catalogued, has no aliases, and the resolver mis-routes assignment phrasings to pattern/detail or composes unrelated recipes.
evidence: all four runs fell back to fallback/native-control with a token-conformant native <select> and marked TODO(authority-undefined)

baseline resolves: 4/8 picker phrasings mis-resolve to pattern/detail; 'assign'/'owner'/'reviewer' have zero search hits (docs/evolution/data/baseline-resolves-0.12.1.json, 27 phrasings re-verified in review)
existing_authority_considered: component/cb - filterable listbox; wrong tool for 4 fixed names (drags listbox JS into a no-JS case)
component/radio - fine for always-visible small choice, not a compact inline assign control
fallback/native-control - already the sanctioned shape, but a fallback is the wrong home for a first-class recurring need
why_insufficient: The visual layer already exists (core/base.css styles select including focus, aria-invalid, phone ergonomics) and every downstream run chose it; what is missing is addressability: no spec entry, no class contract, no aliases, resolver returns mis-routes or UNDEFINED. The need recurred in 4/4 evidence runs - systemic, not project-local.

triage_snapshot: src/core/base.css: add .select as an explicit class alias to the existing select rules (shared control rule L101, focus L103, phone L510-511/L598, aria-invalid L631-633, and the :focus-visible group L732 for parity). Additive selector aliases only - no new declarations, no new visual language.

spec/states.json: add component { class: 'select', name: 'Select (native)', source: 'base.css', status: 'beta', states: ['default','focus','invalid','disabled'], verify: ['.select','.select:focus','.select[aria-invalid="true"]'], a11y: [native semantics + visible label; keyboard is the platform's; 16px on phone to prevent iOS zoom; 44px min touch target (already in base.css); never replace with a JS listbox for small fixed sets] }
site/pages_components.py: show class="select" in the Forms select demo + a11y note.
VERSION + package.json + spec/rules.json + spec/states.json(version) + rename-map.json -> 0.13.0-experiment; CHANGELOG entry.
curation: aliases.json: component/select -> ['select','native select','single select','select control','owner picker','record picker','assign','reviewer'] (evolution of the review list: dropped 'fixed list picker' (delete-probe flips) and 'entity picker' (verified hijack); kept 'record picker' (closes the 4th mis-route); second pass: 'assign picker'/'reviewer picker' phrases de-phrased to single tokens so 'searchable picker' stays with component/cb)
component-notes.json: component/select summary + cross-reference 'for the labelled assign flow (action + outcome) compose recipe/assign-picker'

not_proposed: component/select as a new visual component (c3 proposal) - nothing new to build; REVISE down to documentation
recipe/entity-picker on component/cb (c1 proposal) - wrong ingredient for small fixed sets; kept as guidance inside the recipe instead
compatibility: Additive: bare <select> keeps identical styling; new class alias only. No existing selector semantics altered. No breakage risk for existing implementations (c1-c4 fallbacks remain valid markup).

validation.criterion: achievable contract under the frozen kernel (artifacts take precedence over recipes):
validation.g01_mapping: FINAL (second-pass verified): 6 baseline picker phrasings (#1,#2,#3,#6,#7,#8) -> RESOLVED component/select; #4 ('...from the request detail page') and #5 ('Choose one owner from a list of people') -> COMPOSE recipe/assign-picker; zero pattern/detail mis-routes; zero unrelated-recipe composes; semantics lock: 'searchable picker' phrasing stays with component/cb
validation.triage_gates: build.py check (states matrix at 37 components), strict lint 100/100, additive CSS diff shown explicitly (verify.py's substring check alone is insufficient - .select matches .select-inline)
validation.non_regression: combobox->cb, date picker->dp, loading spinner->spinner, toast->toast2 unchanged; delete battery: 'remove a reviewer from a list', 'remove a person from a list', 'delete a person from a list', 'remove an owner from a list', 'delete an entity from a list', 'remove a reviewer' -> all entity-delete-armed

migration: Existing implementations using a token-styled native select are already conformant; add class="select" for explicit citation on next touch, or keep the bare element (visually identical). The downstream TODO(authority-undefined) markers can be replaced with a citation of recipe/assign-picker.
